moc.chu: It appeared in early November 1572 and was independently discovered by many individuals.
Contrarily, Brahe described the supernova as "brighter than Venus".
The supernova remained visible to the naked eye into early 1574, gradually fading until it disappeared from view.
In October 2004, a letter in Nature reported the discovery of a G2 star, similar in type to our own Sun and named Tycho G.
